Monthly SEO Packages: What Should Be Included?

A checklist for comparing monthly SEO packages by deliverables, responsibilities and useful reporting.

By Cyberfreak Software · 28 November 2026

There is no universal monthly package

Monthly SEO services vary widely. One package might include content briefs and implementation; another might cover technical maintenance, local listings or digital PR. The label “monthly SEO” does not tell you enough. Compare the actual tasks and the time or output committed to each.

A useful package makes its routine clear

Look for an agreed reporting period, a review of search performance, a way to surface issues, a prioritised list of next steps and a named contact. If the package includes changes, ask how many, how they are approved and whether development time is capped.

Separate advice from production

Recommendations and implementation are different activities. A provider may identify content gaps without writing articles, or flag technical issues without changing code. Both models can work, but the package should say which one you are buying. Content volume should not be implied if it is not included.

Read the terms as well as the task list

Check minimum term, cancellation, renewal, onboarding, access and any extra charges. If your website needs substantial repair, ask whether a separate project is needed before monthly monitoring will be useful.
